instruction: Publish Navrang 0.9.0 after the requested physical in-place upgrade and recorded retest of swipes, bottom tabs and Admin Location & audio.
deviceEvidence: X100 Pro accepted the original-signer upgrade from 0.8.0, then the revised 0.9.0 APK installed over the earlier 0.9.0 candidate. Android app ID and first install time remained unchanged. The installed APK SHA-256 matched this signed candidate. Cold launch, invalid QR and short manual ID handling, Account cancellation, Reports tabs, Help Desk quantity and Android settings were exercised on the phone. The revised APK passed recorded left/right swipes, bottom Reports from a long Admin list and the dedicated Admin Location & audio panel. Find Me is unassigned for the event. Voice is unavailable and no audio is connected. Live location sharing, audio and mutating attendee workflows were not exercised.
